investors: Base10 | Peak XV Partners | Y Combinator
summary: AI marketing platform JustAI raised over $17 million in a Series A round led by Base10, with participation from Y Combinator and Peak XV Partners, to expand engineering, go‑to‑market teams and AI infrastructure.

Bengaluru-based spacetech startup QOSMIC raised $3.3 million in a seed round from Prosus, Accel and South Park Commons to expand manufacturing and engineering capabilities for space-to-ground communication infrastructure.

investors: AWE Funds | Callapina Capital | Unicorn India Ventures
summary: Ikin Global, a Mumbai-based IoT smart lock startup for supply chain logistics, raised $2 million in a Pre-Series A2 round led by Unicorn India Ventures, Callapina Capital and AWE Funds to expand globally and develop new products.
Bodycraft, a clinic and salon chain, raised Rs 120 crore in a Series A round led by Singularity AMC to fund expansion and technology upgrades across India.

investors: Bessemer Venture Partners | Nexus Venture Partners | Titan Capital | WEH Ventures
summary: Bengaluru-based cyber resilience startup Mitigata raised $15 million in a Series B round led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with participation from existing investors Nexus Venture Partners, Titan Capital and WEH Ventures.

Sherlocks AI, an AI-native incident management startup, raised Rs 7.5 crore in a pre‑seed round led by SenseAI Ventures with participation from Uppekkha to strengthen its product and expand go‑to‑market efforts in North America.

investors: Abhishek Bansal | Kunal Shah | Zeropearl VC
summary: LiLLBUD, an early learning toy startup for children aged 0–3, raised Rs 6 crore in a seed round led by Zeropearl VC with participation from Abhishek Bansal and Kunal Shah.

STCH, a Bengaluru-based textile tech startup, raised $5.5 million in a pre-Series A round led by Omnivore with participation from Kae Capital and WVC to expand its AI-driven fabric R&D and manufacturing platform.

investors: InfoEdge Ventures | Kae Capital | Susquehanna Venture Capital
summary: GobbleCube, a Gurugram-based AI startup for digital commerce, raised $15 million in a Series A round led by Susquehanna Venture Capital, with participation from InfoEdge Ventures and Kae Capital.

TraqCheck, an HR tech startup, raised $8 million in a Series A round led by IvyCap Ventures with participation from IIFL Fintech Fund to expand its AI‑driven background screening and sourcing agents in Europe.

Pluckk, a digital-first fresh food and clean-label FMCG brand, raised Rs 100 crore in a Series A1 round led by Euro Gulf Investment to expand offline retail, international markets, and AI-driven supply chain capabilities.
Meta is investing around $900 million in fintech unicorn CRED through primary and secondary transactions, making Meta a minority investor.
Quick commerce startup FirstClub raised $55 million in a Series B round from Peak XV Partners and Sofina.

investors: ITI Growth Opportunities Fund | PROMAFT Partners

summary: IndiGo Ventures Fund invested approximately Rs 10 crore in Sarla Aviation, an eVTOL air‑taxi startup, to support its operating and expansion needs.
BharatTender, a B2B procurement marketplace, raised Rs 1.25 crore in a pre‑seed round from an unnamed angel investor to accelerate product development and AI‑powered procurement capabilities.
AI startup Sarvam raised $234 million in the first close of its $300 million Series B round, valuing the company at $1.5 billion.
Zepto filed a draft red herring prospectus to raise Rs 8,010 crore through a fresh issue in its IPO, while reporting doubled revenue and widened losses in FY26.
Rapido raised $240 million in a Series F round, the largest single funding event in India for May 2026.
MoEngage acquired AI startup Aampe for an undisclosed amount; the article mentions prior funding rounds but does not detail a new funding event.
Honasa Consumer acquired a 58% stake in nutraceuticals company Fluence Pharma for an enterprise value of about Rs 135 crore.
Nexus Venture Partners sold Delhivery shares worth Rs 208 crore in a bulk deal, continuing its exit from the logistics company.
Masters’ Union launched{a} Rs 100 crore early-stage investment platform called MU Ventures to fund founders aged under 25 across sectors.
Zerodha Capital, the lending arm of Zerodha Group, reported a 20.5% rise in net profit to Rs 14.7 crore in FY26, with total income up 44.2% to Rs 53.5 crore.
